Definition
[Upper half-space model] \group modelsSource: thurston:page-0021, thurston:page-0022 The upper half-space model is $\{ x_n>0\} \subset \R ^n$ with metric $ds^2=dx^2/x_n^2$. Its hyperbolic lines are circles orthogonal to the boundary plane $\R ^{n-1}$, including vertical lines; Euclidean size is proportional to height above that boundary.
